text_block_list.text:
—That star had always existed above their 
heads.

Stars are farther than the clouds. They 
burn hotter than scorching heat in the 
chest.

...So radiant that you can't take your 
eyes off it.

How many challengers must have reached out 
for that radiance?

How many times have I slammed my fist into 
the ground and choked back my tears?

—However distant it may be. Even if it is 
out of reach.
I couldn't help but crave that victory.
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

It is—the world's grandest stage, where 
only an Umamusume worthy of being "World's 
Best" may challenge.

The pinnacle of the world that Japan has 
been chasing for so long.
"And there, I will stand alongside <chrname>."

“—This is the story of challenging the 
'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe', a victory 
Japan has long dreamed of.”

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Morning! Cafe! Did you see this morning's 
hot news?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...The overseas Umamusume that had been 
rumored... has officially declared her 
entry into the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, 
hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! What about you? Let me hear 
how you're feelin'!"

"The premier educational institution in 
Japan for Umamusume —Tracen Academy."

The reason I chose this as my workplace 
was tied to a certain dream.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer-sanâª ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Will <chrname>'s challenge for the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe be next year?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh? Hmm......

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Excuse me. <chrname>'s debut is still ahead, so 
there's no telling what the future holds, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'll be rooting for you. For the 
day you "train the greatest Umamusume in 
the world"♪

That was a question Chairwoman Akikawa 
fired at me during my final interview 
before joining the Academy.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "What is your dream?!"

The answer I gave back then must have 
seemed entirely unremarkable.
choice_data_list:
...I want to raise the best Umamusume in 
the world.

text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I even wish 'to make someone 
the best in the world.' ...If I were to 
tell her that, I wonder how she would 
react."
choice_data_list:
(…Her dream alone is already more than I 
can handle…)

text_block_list.text:
If you want to raise the best Umamusume in 
the world, you have to become the best 
Trainer in the world first.

I'm not particularly versatile. So, as a 
rookie, I should support my Umamusume with 
everything I've got. Talking about such 
dreams right now is—

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"Attention, all!! All students and 
Trainers are to gather in the gymnasium 
immediately!!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Attention, everyone! I thank you all for 
gathering here despite your busy 
schedules!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Getting straight to today's agenda— I 
shall hand over to someone better suited 
than I to explain."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Mei!! I leave it to you!

text_block_list.name: Nearby Trainers
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Who's that girl? An acquaintance of 
the Chairwoman?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the introduction! I'm Mei 
Satake!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Affiliation: URA Academy Enhancement 
Department! Specializing in European race 
analysis.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I've known Chairwoman Akikawa since she 
was yay high! ...Er, never mind that.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I have come to this academy as the person 
in charge of the newly launched "Project 
L'Arc."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—To win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe with 
you all.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh... No, no, no... Are they really 
serious...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"There are people like that sometimes, 
aren't there? Staying domestic should be 
more than enough..."

All kinds of voices echoed throughout the 
gymnasium. Some had sparkling eyes, while 
others looked doubtful. Amidst them, I—
—I locked eyes with <chrname>.
(KER-CLUNK!)

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Becoming number one in the world is a 
tremendous dream.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Continuing to chase that dream takes 
stamina. It takes time. And it takes money 
too.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Just how steep, harsh, and narrow a road 
it is. There are plenty of people who will 
kindly point that out. But—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Only those who dare to dream can make them 
come true!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I will dream with all my might. A dream 
where a Japanese Umamusume wins the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"To make that happen, we even launched 
'Project L'Arc'! We've made all the 
preparations!"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"Aren't there some among you too? Those 
who truly—want to win the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe!!"
(KER-CLUNK!)

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
We don't care about the aptitudes of those 
who wish to join. It doesn't matter 
whether you're good at turf or dirt.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
If you don't give it a shot, how will you 
know whether you'll win or lose?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: I cheer for the true voice of your heart.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: To see you all—claim victory.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Is this the moment you've been waiting 
for? For you, that is.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ......Shut up.

The assembly ended, and the crowd began to 
disperse. Amidst them—
<chrname> came over.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
If you don't give it a shot, how will you 
know whether you'll win or lose?

That speech from earlier won't leave my 
head. Though that doesn't necessarily mean 
confessing to her will go well.

However, I must not let this opportunity 
slip away. ...That was my immediate 
intuition.
choice_data_list:
Why not take on the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe?

Why not challenge the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe?

text_block_list.text:
A voice trembling so pathetically. And 
waiting for <chrname>'s answer—
—A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Welcome! You came too, <chrname> and company!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
So you all gathered here are the 
participants who applied this time!

—Dozens of Umamusume were inside that 
room.

"Setting her sights on the world, 'The 
Phantom Bird' El Condor Pasa. From the 
prestigious Symboli house, Sirius 
Symboli."

Nakayama Festa, the gambler in search of 
thrills, and Manhattan Cafe, the 
mysterious girl who sees what cannot be 
seen.

Gold Ship, the very embodiment of wild 
unpredictability, and Satono Diamond, the 
young lady of the Satono family...

Compared to the total number of Umamusume 
at Tracen Academy, the group gathered in 
the room was small. Yet, promising 
Umamusume were all assembled here.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to "Project L'Arc." Now then, let 
us aim for—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: The greatest romance in the world!!

And so began the days of striving for 
victory on the world's grandest stage: the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
